critical_flags.justification: Abstract/S4.5/S4.4/S6/Table 5 state that H1 consists of 1,257 instances and that every H1 instance (the whole stratum) has a proof accepted by a formally verified checker. The receipts close H1 over the 13,351-slot capacity universe; ~12,094 rows were screened out of Phase B because 2026-08 bank certificates exist, which were producer-verified by drat-trim only and 'not downloaded or kernel-checked' (PHASE_B_H1_H3_INVENTORY_20260910.md); the October README scopes itself to 'Every H1 residual root'. v5 disclosed the unvalidated bank; v6 removed the disclosure and Table 4 row and calls the bank-replay plan 'superseded'. The disclosure is weakened relative to the AUDITED v5, R-CERT's 'name the remaining gaps' rule is broken, and the BRIEF frontmatter claim is not supported by the receipts.
